# The core artefact inside the Star

First Person direction, 8 September 2026. Design observation; implementation remains proposed.

The Star may carry a chosen image or core artefact in its centre: a “core PFP” for you or your agent on the trust graph. The moving ceiling should make the changing condition of the information held there visible. Carry this expression into the browser extension of the City Key so identity, selected artefact and permitted perspective stay connected.

The centre represents the selected subject of protection, rather than a replacement for the whole agent or its private state. Preserve the existing two tetrahedra, lattice and heart as the geometric foundation. Selecting an image should be optional; the original heart remains the default.

Source inspection makes one distinction essential: the current moving ceiling increases reconstruction reach against fixed information. Its equation does not establish that the information loses bytes, becomes false or expires. “Decay” can express erosion of the privacy margin. Evidence freshness, revocation and retention are separate properties and need separate readings.

The proposed rendering is therefore a stable core portrait or artefact preview with a time-dependent veil or rim. The image remains intact. The rim can show a named scenario or sourced assessment; without assessment data, it reads “unassessed”. Display animation cannot establish compromise or delete the underlying artefact.

In the extension, the core becomes a recognition cue for the selected VTA identity and City Key. Identity control, disclosure approval and City action permission remain distinct checks. The page receives an approved preview, not the full VTA-held artefact or private signing material. A changed observer, audience or disconnected session clears the previous private preview.

Implementation plan: [Core artefact and moving ceiling](../../soulbis%20website/docs/core-artefact-moving-ceiling-plan.md). Extends [Star as model](../STAR_AS_MODEL.md) and [City Key private perspective](../proposals/CITY_KEY_PRIVATE_PERSPECTIVE.md).

Related contemporaneous proposal: [Star core artefact](../proposals/STAR_CORE_ARTEFACT.md). The Soulbis implementation plan resolves its open question about where the active ceiling source lives.
